comment: Registry of podcasts that recur in content/*.json. update-podcast-indexes.sh turns each feedUrl into a per-show episode index at podcasts/<slug>.json. appleId is the Apple Podcasts collection id (the id<NUMBER> in an Apple show URL); it resolves feedUrl via https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=<appleId> when a feed moves.

shows.name: Software Engineering Radio
shows.notes: Most-linked show in the collection. Feed item links point at se-radio.net episode pages.

shows.name: Manager Tools
shows.notes: www.manager-tools.com 403s curl (Cloudflare) but the slug pattern is stable, e.g. /2009/01/horstman%E2%80%99s-law-project-management-part-1-hall-fame-guidance (note the percent-encoded curly apostrophe). The files.manager-tools.com feed host does not block. Hall of Fame casts are re-releases of older casts; use the original cast's date/slug.

shows.name: The Engineering Leadership Podcast (ELC)
shows.notes: sfelc.com intermittently returns 500; confirm slugs via the Simplecast feed or web search.

shows.name: Lenny's Podcast: Product | Career | Growth
shows.notes: Substack feed; item links are the lennysnewsletter.com/p/ post pages. Feed is large (~2 MB); grep it rather than re-fetching.

shows.name: Go Time: Golang, Software Engineering
shows.notes: Canonical URL is just the episode number, e.g. https://changelog.com/gotime/296.

shows.name: Developing Leadership
shows.notes: The apex domain developingleadership.co is parked (domain reseller page); use the podcast. subdomain or a web.archive.org snapshot as alternate-url. Podbean feed still works.

shows.name: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
shows.notes: Colossus site. Feed item links give the episodes/<id>/<slug> URL directly.

shows.name: The Knowledge Project with Shane Parrish
shows.notes: Feed links may point at Megaphone; the fs.blog episode page is the canonical we store.

shows.name: Y Combinator Startup Podcast
shows.notes: Feed (Anchor/Spotify for Creators) links point at podcasters.spotify.com; existing entries use the YC Library video page instead. Search the library for the episode title.

shows.name: Managing Up
shows.notes: Beware a same-named Vietnamese podcast (appleId 1532702553); the repo's show is the Simplecast one.

shows.name: Darknet Diaries
shows.notes: Canonical URL is the episode number.

shows.name: Radical Candor: Communication at Work
shows.notes: radicalcandor.com pages may serve gzipped/binary content to curl; the Megaphone feed is reliable.

shows.name: Engineering Unblocked (Swarmia)
shows.notes: Feed links point at anchor.fm; existing entries use the swarmia.com episode page.

shows.name: The Twenty Minute VC (20VC): Venture Capital | Startup Funding | The Pitch
shows.notes: One feed hosts 20VC/20Growth/20Sales/20Product/The Memo. Libsyn feed items have no <link>; canonical episode pages live on thetwentyminutevc.com under a guest-name slug (repeat guests get -2/-3 suffixes). Feed is ~12 MB, ~1500 episodes.

shows.name: The Peterman Pod
shows.notes: Feed links point at anchor.fm; existing entries use the developing.dev post page (Ryan Peterman's Substack, same site as Developing Leadership).

shows.name: In Depth (First Round)
shows.notes: Megaphone feed items have no <link>; canonical pages live on review.firstround.com/podcast/ with long title-guest-role slugs.

shows.name: The Pragmatic Engineer
shows.notes: Substack feed (feed items include full transcripts); item links are the newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/ post pages, which are the canonical URLs used in content/.

shows.name: Fallthrough
shows.notes: Transistor feed item links are share.transistor.fm/s/<id> shortlinks that do not redirect; existing entries use the fallthrough.transistor.fm/<episode-number> pages. The share page's embedded JSON lists the episode number and hosts. fallthrough.fm 302s to the transistor site.

shows.name: Effective Engineering Manager
shows.notes: Feed items link to effectiveem.com episode pages with utm query params (strip them). Episode titles on the site can differ slightly from Apple trackNames (site is canonical).
